lost_reason: Deal stalled in legal review — procurement introduced too late, competitor moved faster

calls.notes: Strong discovery call. Vikram is the clear champion — very excited about our monitoring stack. Pain: their on-prem infra is crashing 2x per month. CFO Sunita not on call but Vikram says she trusts him. Procurement not mentioned.
Technical deep dive with Vikram and his team. They loved the demo. Asked us to prepare a formal proposal. Still no mention of procurement or legal. Sent proposal directly to Vikram.

Vikram says procurement team has now flagged our proposal — they want 3 vendor quotes. This is the first time procurement is involved. Datadog already submitted their quote 2 weeks ago. We are behind.
red_flags: procurement introduced at Call 3 — too late

calls.notes: Legal review started. Our standard contract has 3 clauses procurement flagged. Datadog apparently has a pre-approved vendor contract. CFO Sunita now involved but leaning toward Datadog because of smoother procurement process.
red_flags: CFO now engaged but biased toward competitor

calls.notes: Lost. Sunita chose Datadog — not because of features but because procurement process was faster and legal review was pre-cleared. Vikram was upset but had no power.

lessons_learned: Ask about procurement process in Call 1 — never assume champion controls the buy
Introduce procurement team by Call 2 maximum
Get legal review started early — contract friction kills deals
If competitor is already in procurement, you are already behind
CFO trust in champion does not mean champion controls final decision
